mmq.text: Ramos is remembered in myth as the sky god who saved people from a clash with his evil brother and brought them to Mercadia, but in truth he is a dragon engine crafted by Urza who gathers victims when the Golgothian Sylex is activated and is sent through a Phyrexian portal.
He falls in the Deepwood, animating ghouls and creating dryads to guard his bones and five power crystals, and the Cho-Arrim take the Weatherlight's arrival as a sign of Ramos's return.
At the Henge of Ramos, he stirs awake and lets the crew take five powerstones to charge the Power Matrix, warning the charge will fade away from him.
During the Revolution on Mercadia, Ramos destroys Volrath's ship Recreant as the Weatherlight flees, and the peoples form a united government.
